enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

values.name: KE_GPU_COMPARE_UNDEFINED
values.doc: No comparison (default for samplers without shadow compare)

values.name: KE_GPU_BINDING_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER
values.doc: read-write storage (compute only)

values.name: KE_GPU_BINDING_TYPE_READONLY_STORAGE_BUFFER
values.doc: read-only storage (usable in fragment)

values.name: KE_GPU_BINDING_TYPE_DEPTH_TEXTURE
values.doc: depth-format texture, sampled or texel-fetched

enums.name: ke_gpu_shader_language
enums.doc: Shader source language a device accepts. Query via `ke_gpu_device::shader_language`.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_TOKEN
values.doc: Holds no memory: reading and writing it only orders passes.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE
values.doc: A ray tracing acceleration structure; a graph without ray tracing refuses it.

enums.name: ke_render_graph_size_class
enums.doc: How a texture's size is given.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_SIZE_ABSOLUTE
values.doc: width and height in texels.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_SIZE_OUTPUT_RELATIVE
values.doc: scale_x and scale_y of the frame's output.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_SIZE_RESOURCE_RELATIVE
values.doc: scale_x and scale_y of the resource relative_to.

enums.name: ke_render_graph_usage
enums.doc: How a pass uses a resource.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT
values.doc: Read as an attachment of the same render pass.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_RESOLVE
values.doc: The single-sampled target a multisampled attachment resolves into.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_COPY_SRC
values.doc: The single-sampled target a multisampled attachment resolves into.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_COPY_DST
values.doc: The single-sampled target a multisampled attachment resolves into.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_VERTEX
values.doc: The single-sampled target a multisampled attachment resolves into.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_INDEX
values.doc: The single-sampled target a multisampled attachment resolves into.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_INDIRECT
values.doc: The single-sampled target a multisampled attachment resolves into.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_UNIFORM
values.doc: The single-sampled target a multisampled attachment resolves into.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_PRESENT
values.doc: Presented once the frame ends.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_READBACK
values.doc: Its bytes are handed to the pass's readback when the frame retires.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_AS_BUILD
values.doc: Its bytes are handed to the pass's readback when the frame retires.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_AS_READ
values.doc: Its bytes are handed to the pass's readback when the frame retires.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_TOKEN_READ
values.doc: Its bytes are handed to the pass's readback when the frame retires.

values.name: KE_RENDER_GRAPH_USAGE_TOKEN_WRITE
values.doc: Its bytes are handed to the pass's readback when the frame retires.

enums.name: ke_render_graph_load
enums.doc: What an attachment holds when its pass starts.

enums.name: ke_render_graph_queue
enums.doc: The queue a pass would rather run on; a graph may run every pass on the graphics queue.

fields.name: copy_bytes_per_row_alignment
fields.doc: Byte multiple a texture/buffer copy's bytes_per_row must be a multiple of; 1 when the backend imposes none.

fields.name: z_zero_to_one
fields.doc: True when clip z is in [0,1] (Vulkan/D3D/WebGPU), false for [-1,1] (GL).

fields.name: y_flip
fields.doc: True when a top-left framebuffer origin needs a Y flip in projection.

structs.name: ke_render_graph_texture_desc
structs.doc: A texture made for one frame.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Shown by capture and validation tools.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Texels, for KE_RENDER_GRAPH_SIZE_ABSOLUTE.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Texels, for KE_RENDER_GRAPH_SIZE_ABSOLUTE.

fields.name: scale_x
fields.doc: The factor of the width it is relative to, for a relative size class.

fields.name: scale_y
fields.doc: The factor of the height it is relative to, for a relative size class.

fields.name: relative_to
fields.doc: The resource whose size it follows, for KE_RENDER_GRAPH_SIZE_RESOURCE_RELATIVE.

fields.name: mip_levels
fields.doc: At least one.

fields.name: array_layers
fields.doc: At least one.

fields.name: samples
fields.doc: At least one; above one, the texture is multisampled.

fields.name: generate_mips
fields.doc: Whether its mips are generated from mip 0 after the last pass of the frame that writes it.

structs.name: ke_render_graph_buffer_desc
structs.doc: A buffer made for one frame.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Shown by capture and validation tools.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Greater than zero.

structs.name: ke_render_graph_use
structs.doc: One use of a resource by a pass.

fields.name: base_mip
fields.doc: The first mip used.

fields.name: mip_count
fields.doc: How many mips; zero means every mip from base_mip.

fields.name: base_layer
fields.doc: The first array layer used.

fields.name: layer_count
fields.doc: How many layers; zero means every layer from base_layer.

fields.name: view_format
fields.doc: The format the pass views the texture in, such as the sRGB alias of a UNORM one; the texture's own format when it is KE_GPU_TEXTURE_FORMAT_INVALID.

fields.name: load
fields.doc: For an attachment.

fields.name: clear_color
fields.doc: The colour a cleared colour attachment starts with.

fields.name: clear_depth
fields.doc: The depth a cleared depth attachment starts with.

fields.name: clear_stencil
fields.doc: The stencil a cleared depth attachment starts with.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Shown by capture and validation tools; copied by the call.

fields.name: injection_point
fields.doc: Orders the passes: a use refers to the last write of its resource by a pass earlier in the order of injection point, then declaration, and passes no dependency orders run with the lower point first.

fields.name: side_effect
fields.doc: Whether the pass runs even when nothing it writes is read.

fields.name: uses
fields.doc: Copied by the call.

fields.name: record
fields.doc: Records the pass.

fields.name: condition
fields.doc: NULL runs the pass every frame.

fields.name: readback
fields.doc: Required when a use is READBACK.

fields.name: user
fields.doc: Forwarded to record, condition and readback.

vtables.name: ke_render_graph_ctx
vtables.doc: What a pass's record sees: what it records into and the resources it declared.

slots.name: encoder
slots.doc: The encoder a copy pass records into.
slots.return_doc: Valid during the record call; NULL in a raster or compute pass.

slots.name: render_pass
slots.doc: The render pass a raster pass records into, begun by the graph with the attachments the pass declared, loaded and cleared as declared, and ended by it after the record.
slots.return_doc: Valid during the record call; NULL in a compute or copy pass.

slots.name: compute_pass
slots.doc: The compute pass a compute pass records into, begun and ended by the graph.
slots.return_doc: Valid during the record call; NULL in a raster or copy pass.

slots.name: texture
slots.doc: The texture behind resource, which the pass declared.
slots.return_doc: The texture; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE for a resource the pass did not declare.

slots.name: texture_view
slots.doc: The view of resource for the pass's use of it.
slots.return_doc: The view; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE for a resource the pass did not declare.

slots.name: buffer
slots.doc: The buffer behind resource, which the pass declared.
slots.return_doc: The buffer; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE for a resource the pass did not declare.

vtables.name: ke_render_graph
vtables.doc: The passes of a frame and the resources between them, declared each frame, then compiled into an order, a lifetime for every resource and the transitions between uses, and executed.

slots.name: begin_frame
slots.doc: Starts declaring a frame whose output is output_width by output_height; what the previous frame declared is forgotten, its exports kept.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a zero size; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED while the previous frame executes.

slots.name: create_texture
slots.doc: Declares a texture made for this frame.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a desc with no meaning; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED for a texture the graph cannot make, such as one whose mips it would generate; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: out_resource
params.doc: Receives the resource; KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: create_buffer
slots.doc: Declares a buffer made for this frame.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a zero size; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: out_resource
params.doc: Receives the resource; KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: create_token
slots.doc: Declares a token, which orders the passes that use it and holds nothing.

params.name: out_resource
params.doc: Receives the resource; KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: import_texture
slots.doc: Declares a texture made outside the graph, such as the swapchain's, which the frame leaves in the state of final_usage.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for an invalid texture or view; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: out_resource
params.doc: Receives the resource; KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: import_buffer
slots.doc: Declares a buffer made outside the graph.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for an invalid buffer; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: out_resource
params.doc: Receives the resource; KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: export_resource
slots.doc: Keeps resource past this frame, as it is once the frame executed, such as a history buffer; a later frame declares it again with import_export.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a token or an unknown resource; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

slots.name: import_export
slots.doc: Declares in this frame a resource an earlier frame exported.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for an export released or never made; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: out_resource
params.doc: Receives the resource; KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: release_export
slots.doc: Frees a kept resource once no executing frame uses it.

slots.name: add_pass
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null record, an unknown resource, a READBACK use without a readback or a usage the resource's kind has no meaning for; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED for a resource or a usage the graph does not offer, such as an acceleration structure without ray tracing; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

slots.name: compile
slots.doc: Orders the passes by their dependencies, then by injection point and declaration; drops every pass whose writes nothing reads unless it has a side effect, writes an export or an imported resource; decides when each resource is made and freed and the transition before each use.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_GENERAL for a cycle, the passes named in the log; the code of a failed condition.

slots.name: execute
slots.doc: Records the compiled passes and submits them in order.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED before compile; the code of the device that refused a resource.

params.name: out_completion
params.doc: Receives the frame's execution, which carries the first failure of a record; the caller releases it.

lanes.name: result
lanes.doc: KE_OK, or the code of the compile that failed, whose reason is logged.

lanes.name: pso
lanes.doc: The pipeline; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE when the compile failed.

callbacks.name: ke_gpu_buffer_mapped_func
callbacks.doc: Receives the outcome of mapping a buffer for reading.

lanes.name: result
lanes.doc: KE_OK when the range is readable through map_buffer until unmap_buffer, or the code of the mapping that failed.

callbacks.name: ke_render_graph_record_fn
callbacks.doc: Records a pass, possibly on another thread and after add_pass returned, through ctx only.

callbacks.name: ke_render_graph_condition_fn
callbacks.doc: Whether a pass runs this frame; asked once, at compile.

callbacks.name: ke_render_graph_readback_fn
callbacks.doc: Receives the bytes of a resource the pass declared READBACK, once the frame retires.
